title: Guest Pass Allowance by Parking License Product
content:
Training note — guest pass figures of the Parking License. Each product gives its license holder a number of guest passes per calendar month and a limit on the consecutive nights one pass may cover.

| Parking product | Guest passes per calendar month | Consecutive nights one pass may cover |
|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | 4 | 3 |
| Surface Reserved Space | 4 | 3 |
| Covered Carport Space | 4 | 3 |
| Structured Garage Space | 6 | 3 |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | 6 | 3 |
| Private Detached Garage | 8 | 3 |

**How many passes does a garage holder have?** A Structured Garage Space or EV Charging Reserved Space license carries 6 passes a month, and a Private Detached Garage license 8; the three uncovered and carport products carry 4.

**How long may one pass run?** Up to 3 consecutive nights on every product.
